authoring: AI 撰寫的學習內容；詞形參考 ECDICT。非官方試題。

entries.en: something encouraging a person to act

examples.en: The bonus provides an incentive to improve.
examples.zh: 這筆獎金提供了進步的誘因。

entries.en: a claim of wrongdoing not yet proved

examples.en: The company denied the allegation.
examples.zh: 公司否認了這項指控。

entries.en: the gradual collection of something

examples.en: The accumulation of unpaid bills caused concern.
examples.zh: 未付帳單不斷累積，引發了擔憂。

entries.en: the ability to keep people or information

examples.en: Better benefits improved employee retention.
examples.zh: 更好的福利提高了員工留任率。

entries.en: work waiting to be completed

examples.en: Extra staff helped clear the order backlog.
examples.zh: 增派人員協助清除了積壓訂單。

entries.en: a company controlled by another company

examples.en: The subsidiary manages regional distribution.
examples.zh: 這家子公司負責區域配送。

entries.en: the customers of a business

examples.en: The café attracts a diverse clientele.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡館吸引了多元顧客群。

entries.en: the purchase of a business or asset

examples.en: The acquisition expanded our service network.
examples.zh: 這次收購擴大了我們的服務網絡。

entries.en: a payment to company shareholders

examples.en: The board approved a quarterly dividend.
examples.zh: 董事會核准了季度股利。

entries.en: a detailed description of requirements

examples.en: The product meets every specification.
examples.zh: 這項產品符合每項規格。

entries.en: a difference between things that should match

examples.en: We found a discrepancy in the invoice.
examples.zh: 我們發現發票內容有出入。

entries.en: the value remaining after debts are deducted

examples.en: The investment increased shareholder equity.
examples.zh: 這項投資增加了股東權益。

entries.en: a formal assessment of value or performance

examples.en: Her annual appraisal was positive.
examples.zh: 她的年度考核結果良好。

entries.en: money received from a sale or event

examples.en: The proceeds will support local charities.
examples.zh: 所得款項將用於支持當地慈善機構。

entries.en: the process of helping new people get started

examples.en: Onboarding includes a safety briefing.
examples.zh: 到職引導包含安全說明。

entries.en: a period of reduced economic activity

examples.en: The recession lowered demand for luxury goods.
examples.zh: 經濟衰退降低了奢侈品需求。

entries.en: a condition in an agreement or the act of supplying

examples.en: This provision allows early cancellation.
examples.zh: 這項規定允許提前取消。

entries.en: specialized knowledge or skill

examples.en: We need expertise in digital marketing.
examples.zh: 我們需要數位行銷方面的專業知識。

entries.en: a formal examination of records or processes

examples.en: The annual audit starts next week.
examples.zh: 年度稽核下週開始。

entries.en: what a system can do

examples.en: The update adds useful functionality.
examples.zh: 這次更新加入了實用功能。

entries.en: payment or arrangements when employment ends

examples.en: Affected staff will receive severance pay.
examples.zh: 受影響的員工將獲得資遣費。

entries.en: money spent on a particular activity

examples.en: Travel expenditure exceeded the estimate.
examples.zh: 差旅支出超過了估算。

entries.en: the increasing connection of international business

examples.en: Globalization has changed supply chains.
examples.zh: 全球化改變了供應鏈。

entries.en: basic systems supporting a place or organization

examples.en: The city invested in transport infrastructure.
examples.zh: 市政府投資了交通基礎建設。

entries.en: the organized purchasing of goods or services

examples.en: Procurement must approve all major purchases.
examples.zh: 所有重大採購都必須經採購部門核准。

entries.en: laws made by a government

examples.en: New legislation affects packaging requirements.
examples.zh: 新法規影響了包裝要求。

entries.en: a large group of different businesses

examples.en: The conglomerate owns several hotel brands.
examples.zh: 這個企業集團擁有數個飯店品牌。

entries.en: an early model used for testing

examples.en: The prototype is ready for user testing.
examples.zh: 原型已可進行使用者測試。

entries.en: total sales or the rate of employee replacement

examples.en: Better training helped reduce staff turnover.
examples.zh: 更好的訓練有助於降低員工流動率。

entries.en: the ability to continue without exhausting resources

examples.en: Sustainability guides our packaging choices.
examples.zh: 永續性是我們選擇包裝的依據。

entries.en: supervision or an unintentional failure to notice

examples.en: The committee provides financial oversight.
examples.zh: 委員會負責財務監督。

entries.en: a right to receive something

examples.en: The policy explains your leave entitlement.
examples.zh: 政策說明了你可享有的休假權益。

entries.en: goods sent together for delivery or sale

examples.en: The consignment arrived at the warehouse.
examples.zh: 這批託運貨物抵達了倉庫。

entries.en: protection of computer systems and data

examples.en: All staff must complete cybersecurity training.
examples.zh: 全體員工必須完成網路安全訓練。

entries.en: a person owning shares in a company

examples.en: Shareholders will vote on the merger.
examples.zh: 股東將對合併案進行投票。

entries.en: a legal responsibility or financial obligation

examples.en: The agreement limits our liability.
examples.zh: 這份協議限制了我們的責任範圍。

entries.en: a record of financial transactions

examples.en: Enter each payment in the ledger.
examples.zh: 請將每筆付款登記在分類帳。

entries.en: a person who examines financial records or systems

examples.en: The auditor requested supporting documents.
examples.zh: 審計師要求提供佐證文件。

entries.en: money paid back for an approved expense

examples.en: Submit receipts to request reimbursement.
examples.zh: 請提交收據申請報銷。

entries.en: the legal authority over an area or matter

examples.en: This matter falls within the agency's jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 這件事屬於該機關的管轄範圍。

entries.en: a clear understanding of something

examples.en: Customer interviews provided valuable insights.
examples.zh: 顧客訪談提供了寶貴見解。

entries.en: extra benefit produced by working together

examples.en: The merger created operational synergies.
examples.zh: 這次合併產生了營運綜效。

entries.en: a high level of skill

examples.en: The position requires proficiency in English.
examples.zh: 這個職位要求熟練的英語能力。

entries.en: a senior manager in an organization

examples.en: The executive approved the expansion plan.
examples.zh: 高階主管核准了擴張計畫。

entries.en: a measurement used to judge performance

examples.en: Customer retention is an important metric.
examples.zh: 顧客留存率是一項重要指標。

entries.en: a group defined by shared population characteristics

examples.en: The campaign targets a younger demographic.
examples.zh: 這次活動鎖定較年輕的族群。

entries.en: an asset offered as security for a loan

examples.en: The bank requires collateral for the loan.
examples.zh: 銀行要求這筆貸款提供擔保品。

entries.en: a person working under another's authority

examples.en: The supervisor gave clear instructions to subordinates.
examples.zh: 主管向部屬下達了清楚的指示。

entries.en: efforts to connect with a wider community

examples.en: The team expanded its community outreach.
examples.zh: 團隊擴大了社區服務。

entries.en: a group directing an organization

examples.en: The board approved the annual budget.
examples.zh: 董事會核准了年度預算。

entries.en: to stop working suddenly or fall sharply

examples.en: The computer crashed during the presentation.
examples.zh: 電腦在簡報期間當機了。

entries.en: to stop an activity

examples.en: Production will cease during maintenance.
examples.zh: 維護期間將停止生產。

entries.en: to obtain legal protection for an invention

examples.en: The company patented its new design.
examples.zh: 公司為新設計取得了專利。

entries.en: to treat with consideration or follow

examples.en: Please respect other guests' privacy.
examples.zh: 請尊重其他房客的隱私。

entries.en: to break a rule or agreement

examples.en: Sharing the files would breach confidentiality.
examples.zh: 分享這些檔案會違反保密義務。

entries.en: to distribute content to several publishers

examples.en: The agency syndicates articles to regional newspapers.
examples.zh: 這家機構向多家地方報紙提供文章。

entries.en: required to explain actions or results

examples.en: Managers are accountable for department spending.
examples.zh: 經理必須對部門支出負責。

entries.en: able to affect opinions or decisions

examples.en: She is an influential industry advisor.
examples.zh: 她是業界具有影響力的顧問。

entries.en: possible and practical to achieve

examples.en: The revised schedule is feasible.
examples.zh: 修訂後的時程可行。

entries.en: seeming reasonable or believable

examples.en: The technician offered a plausible explanation.
examples.zh: 技術人員提出了合理的解釋。

entries.en: done without delay

examples.en: Thank you for your prompt response.
examples.zh: 感謝你迅速回覆。

entries.en: large enough to be important

examples.en: The upgrade required considerable investment.
examples.zh: 這次升級需要相當大的投資。

entries.en: relating to office or professional work

examples.en: Demand for white-collar workers increased.
examples.zh: 白領工作者的需求增加了。

entries.en: done before a fuller examination

examples.en: The preliminary results are encouraging.
examples.zh: 初步結果令人鼓舞。

entries.en: helping a particular result happen

examples.en: Quiet spaces are conducive to focused work.
examples.zh: 安靜的空間有助於專注工作。

entries.en: certain to happen

examples.en: Some delays are inevitable during relocation.
examples.zh: 搬遷期間有些延誤難以避免。

entries.en: able to work successfully over time

examples.en: We need a viable long-term strategy.
examples.zh: 我們需要可長期實行的策略。

entries.en: possible to predict

examples.en: No major changes are planned for the foreseeable future.
examples.zh: 可預見的未來沒有重大變更計畫。

entries.en: belonging separately to each person or thing

examples.en: Return to your respective departments.
examples.zh: 請返回各自的部門。

entries.en: widely respected or well known

examples.en: A renowned architect designed the hotel.
examples.zh: 這家飯店由知名建築師設計。

entries.en: large in amount or importance

examples.en: The changes produced substantial savings.
examples.zh: 這些變更節省了大量成本。

entries.en: very great and often sudden

examples.en: The company announced drastic cost reductions.
examples.zh: 公司宣布大幅削減成本。

entries.en: how easily people can reach or use something

examples.en: The renovation improves wheelchair accessibility.
examples.zh: 整修改善了輪椅使用者的通行便利性。

entries.en: combining well to improve a result

examples.en: The partners have complementary skills.
examples.zh: 這些合作夥伴的技能相互補足。

entries.en: common in a particular place or time

examples.en: Mobile payments are prevalent in this market.
examples.zh: 行動支付在這個市場相當普遍。

entries.en: excellent or still unpaid

examples.en: Please pay the outstanding balance.
examples.zh: 請支付尚未付清的餘額。

entries.en: spread across different types or areas

examples.en: The firm has a diversified investment portfolio.
examples.zh: 這家公司擁有多元化投資組合。

entries.en: easy to understand without detailed instruction

examples.en: The application has an intuitive interface.
examples.zh: 這款應用程式的介面直覺易懂。

entries.en: well known or easily noticed

examples.en: Place the notice in a prominent location.
examples.zh: 請將公告放在顯眼的位置。

entries.en: likely or hoping to become something

examples.en: The tour is open to prospective tenants.
examples.zh: 這場參觀活動開放給有意承租的人。

entries.en: including all important details

examples.en: The course offers comprehensive safety training.
examples.zh: 這門課程提供全面的安全訓練。

entries.en: extremely important and necessary

examples.en: It is imperative to protect customer data.
examples.zh: 保護顧客資料極為必要。

entries.en: inactive but able to become active again

examples.en: The bank will review dormant accounts.
examples.zh: 銀行將檢視久未使用的帳戶。

entries.en: recognized and operating for some time

examples.en: We partnered with an established supplier.
examples.zh: 我們與一家經營已久的供應商合作。

entries.en: highly respected and admired

examples.en: She received a prestigious industry award.
examples.zh: 她獲得了享有盛名的業界獎項。

entries.en: technically advanced or complex

examples.en: The system uses sophisticated monitoring tools.
examples.zh: 這套系統使用先進的監控工具。

entries.en: unusually good or uncommon

examples.en: The hotel provides exceptional service.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供卓越服務。

entries.en: relating to the work of managers

examples.en: The role requires managerial experience.
examples.zh: 這個職位需要管理經驗。

entries.en: lawful or reasonable

examples.en: The refund request is legitimate.
examples.zh: 這項退款要求是正當的。

entries.en: not based on a clear reason or rule

examples.en: Employees questioned the arbitrary deadline.
examples.zh: 員工質疑這個缺乏依據的期限。

entries.en: existing beneath the visible situation

examples.en: We must identify the underlying problem.
examples.zh: 我們必須找出根本問題。

entries.en: providing a final or clear answer

examples.en: A definitive schedule will be released tomorrow.
examples.zh: 最終時程將於明天公布。

entries.en: relating to government finances or financial years

examples.en: Our fiscal year begins in April.
examples.zh: 我們的會計年度從四月開始。

entries.en: required or described by a contract

examples.en: Both sides fulfilled their contractual obligations.
examples.zh: 雙方都履行了合約義務。

entries.en: extremely useful or valuable

examples.en: Her experience proved invaluable to the team.
examples.zh: 她的經驗對團隊極有價值。

entries.en: harmful or unfavorable

examples.en: Adverse weather delayed the shipment.
examples.zh: 惡劣天氣延誤了貨運。

entries.en: lacking something necessary

examples.en: The report is deficient in supporting evidence.
examples.zh: 這份報告缺少佐證。

entries.en: failing to take proper care

examples.en: The contractor was negligent in checking the wiring.
examples.zh: 承包商疏於檢查配線。

entries.en: focused on practical results

examples.en: We took a pragmatic approach to the problem.
examples.zh: 我們以務實的方法處理問題。

entries.en: planned to achieve a long-term goal

examples.en: The new location offers a strategic advantage.
examples.zh: 新地點具有策略優勢。
